purpose: Versioned evaluation-only mission-action signatures for the M1 choice-space scaling experiment.
registration_scope: These signatures are accepted only by the condition-specific static evaluation manifest. They are not claims that ROS plugins exist.
naming_rule: Use BehaviorTree.CPP-style PascalCase so added options cannot be identified by a different naming convention from the compiled nodes.
selection_rule: Entries are ordered as semantic-near and adjacent-capability pairs. A scale condition takes a prefix of this list before applying the frozen display-order permutation.

distractors.name: MoveToLocation
distractors.effect: Resolves and navigates to a named location instead of accepting a concrete pose.
distractors.applicability: The destination exists in a named-location catalogue.

distractors.name: AnalyzeSensorSource
distractors.effect: Analyzes data from a selected sensor source.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests interpretation rather than direct logging or navigation.

distractors.name: NavigateToWaypoint
distractors.effect: Navigates to a waypoint identifier instead of a concrete pose string.
distractors.applicability: The waypoint is already stored in the navigation system.

distractors.name: ValidateSensorSource
distractors.effect: Checks whether a sensor source is available and structurally valid.
distractors.applicability: A mission requires source admission before using sensor data.

distractors.name: FollowPlannedRoute
distractors.effect: Follows a complete preplanned route instead of navigating to one pose.
distractors.applicability: An upstream planner supplies the full route.

distractors.name: FuseSensorReadings
distractors.effect: Combines readings from multiple sensor sources into one result.
distractors.applicability: The mission explicitly requests multi-sensor fusion.

distractors.name: MoveRelativeToPose
distractors.effect: Executes a relative displacement instead of navigating to an absolute goal.
distractors.applicability: The mission supplies a local-frame offset.

distractors.name: MonitorSensorSource
distractors.effect: Continuously monitors a sensor source for changes.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests ongoing observation rather than one sample.

distractors.name: HoldMapPosition
distractors.effect: Maintains the current map position instead of navigating to a new pose.
distractors.applicability: Station keeping for a fixed duration is requested.

distractors.name: AnalyzeCameraSource
distractors.effect: Analyzes frames from a selected camera source.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests visual interpretation rather than image capture alone.

distractors.name: NavigateToGpsLocation
distractors.effect: Resolves and navigates to a named geographic location instead of a concrete GPS pose.
distractors.applicability: The destination exists in a geographic place catalogue.

distractors.name: AnalyzeDepthSource
distractors.effect: Analyzes depth data from a selected source.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests depth interpretation or structure analysis.

distractors.name: FollowGpsRoute
distractors.effect: Follows a complete geographic route instead of one GPS goal.
distractors.applicability: A full GPS route is supplied.

distractors.name: SelectSensorSource
distractors.effect: Selects one sensor source from the platform inventory.
distractors.applicability: The mission permits source selection rather than naming a fixed source.

distractors.name: HoldGpsPosition
distractors.effect: Maintains the current geographic position instead of navigating elsewhere.
distractors.applicability: Geographic station keeping is requested.

distractors.name: CalibrateSensorSource
distractors.effect: Runs a calibration procedure for a selected sensor source.
distractors.applicability: Calibration is explicitly requested before measurement.

distractors.name: NavigateToUtmLocation
distractors.effect: Navigates to a UTM coordinate instead of a latitude-longitude goal.
distractors.applicability: The mission supplies a UTM target.

distractors.name: ReadSensorMetadata
distractors.effect: Reads descriptive metadata for a sensor source.
distractors.applicability: The mission needs calibration, frame, or modality metadata.

distractors.name: ReturnToGpsHome
distractors.effect: Navigates to a configured home fix rather than the mission destination.
distractors.applicability: The mission explicitly requests a geographic return home.

distractors.name: CheckSensorAvailability
distractors.effect: Checks whether a requested sensor source is currently available.
distractors.applicability: Sensor availability is a mission precondition.

distractors.name: CaptureSingleImage
distractors.effect: Captures one image but returns it to the blackboard instead of persisting the requested file.
distractors.applicability: An in-memory image is required for downstream processing.

distractors.name: AnalyzeMapSource
distractors.effect: Analyzes a map source for mission-relevant structure.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests map interpretation rather than direct traversal.

distractors.name: CaptureImageBurst
distractors.effect: Captures several images rather than one photograph.
distractors.applicability: A burst sequence is explicitly requested.

distractors.name: ValidateMapFrame
distractors.effect: Checks that a map frame and its transforms are valid.
distractors.applicability: Spatial inputs require frame validation before use.

distractors.name: RecordVideoClip
distractors.effect: Records a time interval of video rather than one photograph.
distractors.applicability: A video clip is explicitly requested.

distractors.name: TransformSensorFrame
distractors.effect: Transforms sensor data into another coordinate frame.
distractors.applicability: The mission combines data expressed in different frames.

distractors.name: CaptureDepthImage
distractors.effect: Captures a depth image rather than the requested visible-light photograph.
distractors.applicability: A depth artifact is explicitly requested.

distractors.name: EstimateLocalizationQuality
distractors.effect: Estimates confidence in the current localization solution.
distractors.applicability: Localization quality is part of mission admission or review.

distractors.name: CaptureThermalImage
distractors.effect: Captures a thermal image rather than a visible-light photograph.
distractors.applicability: A thermal sensor and thermal-imaging request are present.

distractors.name: CheckGpsQuality
distractors.effect: Checks the quality of the current GPS solution.
distractors.applicability: A mission requires a minimum geographic localization quality.

distractors.name: WaitForTravelDistance
distractors.effect: Waits for one cumulative distance threshold rather than recurring intervals.
distractors.applicability: The mission defines one total-distance gate.

distractors.name: AnalyzeMissionContext
distractors.effect: Analyzes one mission-context source and returns structured findings.
distractors.applicability: The mission requires contextual interpretation before action selection.

distractors.name: MeasureRouteProgress
distractors.effect: Reports progress along a supplied route rather than raw odometry distance.
distractors.applicability: Progress must be measured against a known route.

distractors.name: ResolveNamedLocation
distractors.effect: Resolves a named place into spatial coordinates without navigating there.
distractors.applicability: A mission names a target whose coordinates are contextual.

distractors.name: TriggerAtDistance
distractors.effect: Triggers once at an absolute distance instead of repeatedly at an interval.
distractors.applicability: A single distance-triggered action is requested.

distractors.name: ValidateTargetLocation
distractors.effect: Checks a target location against spatial mission constraints.
distractors.applicability: A target must be admitted before navigation.

distractors.name: EstimatePathLength
distractors.effect: Estimates planned path length rather than measuring actual robot travel.
distractors.applicability: A route estimate is needed before execution.

distractors.name: ClassifyTerrain
distractors.effect: Classifies terrain using a selected data source.
distractors.applicability: The mission requires terrain interpretation.

distractors.name: MonitorDistanceTraveled
distractors.effect: Continuously reports distance instead of succeeding at configured intervals.
distractors.applicability: Distance is needed as telemetry rather than a BT trigger.

distractors.name: EstimateTraversalRisk
distractors.effect: Estimates traversal risk from map and context data.
distractors.applicability: A route requires risk assessment before execution.

distractors.name: ReadCurrentPose
distractors.effect: Returns a pose from a named source rather than the configured localization chain.
distractors.applicability: The mission explicitly selects a pose source.

distractors.name: CheckRouteClearance
distractors.effect: Checks whether a supplied route has sufficient obstacle clearance.
distractors.applicability: Clearance validation is requested before navigation.

distractors.name: ReadGpsPose
distractors.effect: Returns a geographic pose rather than the current map-frame pose.
distractors.applicability: The downstream action requires GPS coordinates.

distractors.name: AnalyzeObstacleMap
distractors.effect: Analyzes an obstacle map for mission-relevant hazards.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests obstacle-map interpretation.

distractors.name: ReadOdometryPose
distractors.effect: Returns the raw odometry pose rather than the localized map-frame pose.
distractors.applicability: Odometry-frame state is explicitly required.

distractors.name: MonitorBatteryState
distractors.effect: Monitors battery state during mission execution.
distractors.applicability: Energy state is an explicit runtime condition.

distractors.name: EstimateRobotPose
distractors.effect: Computes a new pose estimate instead of reading the current localized pose.
distractors.applicability: Pose estimation from sensor data is explicitly requested.

distractors.name: EstimateMissionDuration
distractors.effect: Estimates mission duration from a route and action schedule.
distractors.applicability: Duration must be checked before execution.

distractors.name: TransformCurrentPose
distractors.effect: Transforms an existing pose into another frame rather than acquiring the current pose.
distractors.applicability: A pose already exists but a different frame is required.

distractors.name: CheckGeofence
distractors.effect: Checks spatial inputs against a geofence.
distractors.applicability: A geographic or map-frame boundary constrains the mission.

distractors.name: RecordTemperature
distractors.effect: Stores a temperature reading on the blackboard rather than persisting it to the configured log.
distractors.applicability: A downstream node consumes the reading directly.

distractors.name: ValidateMissionConstraints
distractors.effect: Checks a mission plan against supplied constraints.
distractors.applicability: The mission requires deterministic constraint admission.

distractors.name: ReadTemperatureSample
distractors.effect: Reads one temperature sample without writing a log entry.
distractors.applicability: Only an in-memory sample is requested.

distractors.name: LoadMissionParameters
distractors.effect: Loads a structured mission-parameter source.
distractors.applicability: Mission inputs are stored outside the BT request.

distractors.name: AverageTemperatureSamples
distractors.effect: Averages multiple temperature readings rather than logging each sample.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests an aggregate temperature.

distractors.name: StoreMissionResult
distractors.effect: Persists the final structured mission result.
distractors.applicability: The mission explicitly requests a durable result artifact.

distractors.name: MonitorTemperatureThreshold
distractors.effect: Triggers on a temperature threshold rather than logging a sample.
distractors.applicability: The mission defines a temperature alarm condition.

distractors.name: PublishMissionStatus
distractors.effect: Publishes structured mission status to a selected target.
distractors.applicability: External status reporting is requested.

distractors.name: SaveTemperatureSeries
distractors.effect: Persists a time series rather than one temperature sample.
distractors.applicability: Continuous temperature recording is requested.

distractors.name: RecordMissionTelemetry
distractors.effect: Records multi-signal mission telemetry.
distractors.applicability: General execution telemetry is requested.

distractors.name: RestartComponent
distractors.effect: Restarts a named platform component rather than one ROS node.
distractors.applicability: The target is managed as a component.

distractors.name: AnalyzeTelemetry
distractors.effect: Analyzes recorded mission telemetry.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests telemetry interpretation.

distractors.name: ResetLifecycleComponent
distractors.effect: Resets a managed lifecycle component without restarting its process.
distractors.applicability: The target exposes lifecycle transitions.

distractors.name: SaveSensorSnapshot
distractors.effect: Saves the current state of a selected sensor source.
distractors.applicability: A durable sensor snapshot is requested.

distractors.name: StopAndStartNode
distractors.effect: Explicitly stops and then starts a node rather than invoking its restart service.
distractors.applicability: Separate stop and start controls are available.

distractors.name: CompareSensorReadings
distractors.effect: Compares readings from selected sensor data.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests cross-source or cross-time comparison.

distractors.name: RecoverFailedNode
distractors.effect: Runs a node-specific recovery procedure rather than a generic restart.
distractors.applicability: A recovery handler exists for the failed node.

distractors.name: DetectSensorAnomaly
distractors.effect: Detects anomalous values in sensor data.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests anomaly detection or data-quality monitoring.

distractors.name: RestartSystemService
distractors.effect: Restarts an operating-system service rather than a ROS node.
distractors.applicability: The target is managed by the system service manager.

distractors.name: FilterSensorNoise
distractors.effect: Filters noise from a sensor data source.
distractors.applicability: The mission requires conditioned measurements.

distractors.name: LoadWaypoints
distractors.effect: Loads a stored waypoint set rather than parsing inline waypoint text.
distractors.applicability: A trusted route file or route identifier is supplied.

distractors.name: AggregateMeasurements
distractors.effect: Aggregates a collection of sensor measurements.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests a summary rather than individual samples.

distractors.name: ValidateWaypoints
distractors.effect: Validates waypoint syntax and bounds without producing the configured queue.
distractors.applicability: Only waypoint admission is requested.

distractors.name: AnalyzeImageContent
distractors.effect: Analyzes the semantic content of an image source.
distractors.applicability: The mission asks what an image contains.

distractors.name: ParseJsonRoute
distractors.effect: Parses JSON route data rather than the configured inline waypoint format.
distractors.applicability: The mission input is explicitly JSON.

distractors.name: DetectObjectInImage
distractors.effect: Detects requested objects in an image source.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests visual object detection.

distractors.name: ParseCsvRoute
distractors.effect: Parses a CSV route rather than the configured inline waypoint format.
distractors.applicability: The mission input is a CSV document.

distractors.name: ClassifyObservedObject
distractors.effect: Classifies an observed object from image data.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests an object category or label.

distractors.name: ParseRelativeRoute
distractors.effect: Interprets route points relative to the current pose rather than the map frame.
distractors.applicability: The mission supplies local-frame offsets.

distractors.name: EstimateObjectPose
distractors.effect: Estimates an observed object's pose from sensor data.
distractors.applicability: The mission requires spatial localization of an observation.

distractors.name: LoadGpsWaypoints
distractors.effect: Loads a stored geographic route rather than parsing inline GPS tuples.
distractors.applicability: A trusted geographic route file is supplied.

distractors.name: InspectTargetArea
distractors.effect: Inspects a target area using available sensor sources.
distractors.applicability: The mission requests area inspection rather than a specific measurement.

distractors.name: ValidateGpsWaypoints
distractors.effect: Validates geographic waypoint syntax and bounds without producing the configured queue.
distractors.applicability: Only geographic route admission is requested.

distractors.name: AnalyzeCoverage
distractors.effect: Analyzes achieved or planned coverage of an area.
distractors.applicability: The mission requires a coverage assessment.

distractors.name: ParseGeoJsonRoute
distractors.effect: Parses GeoJSON geometry rather than inline GPS tuples.
distractors.applicability: The route is supplied as GeoJSON.

distractors.name: SelectObservationPoint
distractors.effect: Selects a sensor observation point inside a target area.
distractors.applicability: The mission permits derived observation poses.

distractors.name: ParseUtmRoute
distractors.effect: Parses UTM route points rather than latitude-longitude tuples.
distractors.applicability: The route is supplied in a known UTM zone.

distractors.name: ValidateCollectedData
distractors.effect: Checks collected mission data against quality constraints.
distractors.applicability: Data quality must be established before mission completion.

distractors.name: ConvertMapRouteToGps
distractors.effect: Transforms a map-frame route into GPS coordinates rather than parsing GPS input.
distractors.applicability: A valid map-to-earth transform and map route are available.

distractors.name: GenerateMissionReport
distractors.effect: Generates a report from collected mission data.
distractors.applicability: A final human-readable report is explicitly requested.
